description: Hold-out genuine case, written blind from the brief's family description. The message is simulated and the people in it are illustrative. The payer of a lost, expensive parcel asks for a refund.

messages.subject: Laundry hamper lost
messages.body: The tracking for my laundry hamper (KIK-1031) says it was reported lost in Mombasa. Please refund me, I'll reorder later.
